Static extraction is not certification: authentication, permissions, validation and error paths require manual review of the handler and shared helpers.
Test candidates are filename/domain hints, not proof of exact route coverage.
Dispatch applies rate limiting to GET/POST/PATCH; OPTIONS preflight bypasses it; route errors use statusCode or 500; unmatched GET falls through to static app when enabled.
